newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Totta, Sotto move on presentation.
newsitem.headline: Totta, Sotto move on presentation.

text.p: Shares in Champalimaud group banks Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) were falling four percent and Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) was recovering from early lows after the group made a presentation to analysts, including first quarter results.
"Today, there was a presentation by the Champalimaud group to analysts in which future strategy was discussed along with the first quarter results.
The results were also given to international news agencies but with an embargo for 1530 GMT.
"If for Sotto there is a growth in net profit, the same cannot be said for Totta, which is why the market is penalising Totta," said one trader who attended the presentation.
Totta was down 4.05 percent at 2,414 escudos while Sotto, which went ex-dividend on Thursday, was down just 27 escudos at 1,229 having touched a low of 1,185 escudos before the presentation.
